# Issue triage conventions

Claim2Core work should be tracked through parent roadmap issues and small, reviewable child issues.

- `good first issue`: narrowly scoped, independently testable work that does not require prior knowledge of the sched_ext/BPF hot path.
- `help wanted`: meaningful work suitable for external contributors, but requiring subsystem context.
- `enhancement`: feature or architecture work.
- `documentation`: documentation-only changes.

For Claim2Core, link the parent issue (`#141`, `#133`, `#134`, `#144`, `#145`, or `#146`) and state the exact sub-scope you want to own before implementation.
